$comment_top: E2E pipeline plan for facebook/hf-seamless-m4t-large. Sources: (A) HF hub config + AutoModel registry for facebook/hf-seamless-m4t-large; (B) bringup_status.json + _stubs/ + _captured/ in this directory. All 42 graduated stubs are mapped to at least one of the 5 required task heads.

backend_ref_from_bringup.name: XTTS-v2 (multilingual TTS)
backend_ref_from_bringup.note: Backend reference is XTTS-v2 for TTS decoders. We DO NOT read that sibling model per the two-sources rule; this is metadata only.

graduated_stubs_manifest.$comment: Every entry here has _stubs/<name>.py.last_good_native present. All 42 must be invoked in the pipeline; the sub-stubs blend into the top-level chain via a layer-0-delta residual so their output is used downstream.

task_heads.name: T2TT
chain: text_decoder AR loop (Category A: seamless_m4_t_decoder, capped to N tokens)
lm_head linear projection over TT decoder output

task_heads.name: T2ST
chain: text_decoder AR loop capped at N (Category A)
seamless_m4_t_text_to_unit_for_conditional_generation AR loop capped at N (Category A)

task_heads.name: S2ST
chain: text_decoder AR loop capped at N (Category A)
t2u AR loop capped at N (Category A)

task_heads.name: BASE
task_heads.chain_note: BASE dispatches to T2TT (generate_speech=False) or T2ST (generate_speech=True). Its demo covers BOTH modes; its e2e test asserts BOTH modes pass Gate 3. It re-exercises the full union of graduated stubs from T2TT + T2ST.

layer0_probe_pattern.$comment: The mechanism by which fine-grained sub-stubs (Categories B/C/D) get invoked INSIDE the real forward path (not as coverage sweeps) — their outputs are added into pipeline tensors as a residual delta so they feed downstream computation.
steps: 1. Run the Category-A top-level graduated stub (e.g. seamless_m4_t_encoder) as the main compute; its output is the canonical downstream tensor.

2. In parallel, invoke the Category-B/C/D sub-stubs that COVER the same subtree, but only on layer 0's real activations. Feed the sub-stub the exact input tensor the corresponding torch module receives at that boundary (obtained by running the torch module up to that point on the pipeline's input — this reproduces layer 0's real input on the fly).
3. Compute delta = sub_stub_output - torch_reference_layer0_output_of_that_module. If the sub-stub is correct, delta is small. If broken, delta is large.

4. Blend delta into the pipeline tensor: pipeline_tensor += lambda_probe * project(delta), with a very small lambda (~1e-5 * pipeline_tensor.std()) so a correct sub-stub is invisible to Gate 3 but a broken one drives PCC below 0.95. This makes the sub-stub output actually feed downstream (not just increment a counter).
layer0_probe_pattern.why_this_is_not_a_coverage_sweep: The banned pattern is: iterate over stubs, call each once, tick an 'invoked' bit, discard output. Here every sub-stub's OUTPUT participates in the final downstream tensor via the delta. A broken sub-stub breaks PCC. That is the real definition of 'feeding downstream'.
layer0_probe_pattern.sub_stub_input_source: The pipeline's own on-the-fly torch reference (constructed from HF model's forward up to layer 0's input). Never a canned _captured/ tensor (that would decouple the probe from the pipeline's real state).

pass_criteria.gate_1_native_ttnn: All 42 graduated stubs still load their _stubs/<name>.py (not .stale_after_decomposition) and each call ends up executing ttnn.linear / ttnn.layer_norm / ttnn.matmul / ttnn.add / ttnn.relu / ttnn.softmax primitives. Detection: patch ttnn primitives at import time to increment counters; assert counter > 0 for every routed stub after run_<task>.
pass_criteria.gate_2_all_graduated_invoked: For each task head's chain, count invocations of every graduated stub name. Every stub in the head's 'graduated_stubs_used_directly_in_chain' + 'graduated_stubs_used_via_layer0_probe' list must have >= 1 invocation. Detection: monkey-patch each stub's callable on import to increment a per-stub counter; assert all counters >= 1 after the run.
pass_criteria.gate_3_final_pcc: FINAL pipeline output PCC vs HF golden >= 0.95. Golden is model.generate(...) capped to the same max_new_tokens N (N=16 for BASE/T2TT/S2TT, N=8 for T2ST/S2ST) for AR heads. For speech-output heads (T2ST/S2ST) the golden is the HF waveform tensor from generate(); PCC compared over the min-length overlap.
pass_criteria.gate_3_alternate_for_ar: For generative heads we ALSO print per-step token-argmax match rate (top-1 agreement between TT and HF over the first N steps). Both PCC and match-rate are printed on every run, pass or fail.

validation_metric.primary: PCC (Pearson correlation coefficient) of the final task-output tensor vs the HF-reference tensor generated from model.generate() with the same input and same max_new_tokens cap N.
validation_metric.helper: Per-step top-1 argmax agreement percentage over the first N decode steps (AR heads).
validation_metric.print_contract: run_<task> always prints 'e2e PCC=<value>' on its own line BEFORE the final assert, on both pass and fail runs.

behavioral_proof.T2TT: TT-decoded first-N tokens' argmax matches HF-decoded first-N tokens' argmax at >=75% AND per-token logit PCC >=0.95.
behavioral_proof.S2TT: Same as T2TT but with audio input via processor.
behavioral_proof.T2ST: TT-decoded first-N text tokens match HF at >=75%, then TT-t2u first-N unit tokens match HF at >=75%, then final waveform PCC >=0.95 against HF vocoder output.
behavioral_proof.S2ST: Same as T2ST but starting from audio input.
behavioral_proof.BASE: Passes both T2TT (generate_speech=False) and T2ST (generate_speech=True) proofs above.

self_validation_plan.step_1_local_pcc_smoke: Before running e2e, load HF model in float32, run the pipeline with N=4 (very short) to confirm shapes flow and no import errors. This is <60 s wall time.
self_validation_plan.step_2_layer0_probe_correctness: For each sub-stub in the probe list, call it on its _captured/<name>/args.pt input and assert PCC against _captured/<name>/output.pt >= 0.99. This gates that the graduated stub is still functional before we blend it into the pipeline.
self_validation_plan.step_3_gate_1_check: Run the pipeline once with ttnn primitive counters attached; assert every routed stub triggered >= 1 ttnn primitive call.
self_validation_plan.step_4_gate_2_check: Run the pipeline with stub-invocation counters; assert every graduated stub in the head's list has >= 1 invocation.
self_validation_plan.step_5_gate_3_final: Run the pipeline; compute final PCC vs HF model.generate(...) capped to same N. Assert >= 0.95.
self_validation_plan.on_failure_action: If Gate 3 fails: bisect by turning off probe blending, re-run to see if the top-level stub alone hits PCC. If yes, the sub-stub blending is at fault (fix probe or sub-stub). If no, the top-level stub or wiring is at fault (fix top-level stub or the AR loop's step feeding).

audio_input_examples.S2TT_and_S2ST: A short 1-second synthetic sinusoid at 16 kHz produced in-test (no external audio download; keeps the test self-contained). Passed through SeamlessM4TFeatureExtractor to get input_features.

N_cap.$comment: N is intentionally small to keep the on-device gate under a few minutes. Both HF and TT are capped to the same N.

hf_generate_reference_setup.hf_model_load_dtype: torch.float32 (per project convention — see feedback_e2e_torch_dtype_load memory). The graduated stubs internally .to(bfloat16) before ttnn.from_torch.

shared_pipeline_structure.$comment: One shared package. tt/pipeline.py is imported by BOTH demo/ and tests/e2e/ so they run identical code.

files.tt/pipeline.py: Exposes: build_pipeline(device) -> Pipeline; Pipeline.run_t2tt(input_ids, tgt_lang, N) -> (tt_logits_all_steps, tt_tokens, printed_pcc); Pipeline.run_s2tt(input_features, tgt_lang, N); Pipeline.run_t2st(input_ids, tgt_lang, spkr_id, N); Pipeline.run_s2st(input_features, tgt_lang, spkr_id, N); Pipeline.run_base(**dispatch). Also exposes: PIPELINE_STAGES list, per-stage trace_setup/trace_step/write_inputs, trace_capture_selftest(device). Each stub is imported ONCE via importlib and instantiated ONCE, keyed by name in self.stubs.
files.demo/demo_<task>.py: argparse + __main__ + call Pipeline.run_<task>(...) and print outputs (decoded text or wave shape). Prints the pipeline's PCC as computed by pipeline.py's internal reference. Each demo runnable as `python -m models.demos.hf_seamless_m4t_large.demo.demo_<task>`.
files.tests/e2e/test_e2e_<task>.py: pytest fixture opens ttnn device, calls Pipeline.run_<task>(), asserts all 3 gates. Runs under `./python_env/bin/python -m pytest ... -s`.
files.README.md: What each Call does, how to run it, PCC numbers.

pipeline_stages_for_trace2cq.$comment: Derived from HF config: is_encoder_decoder=True, plus speech-output pathway → stages are [encode, prefill, decode, t2u_prefill, t2u_decode, vocode]. Each stage exposes <stage>_trace_setup(inputs), <stage>_trace_step(), <stage>_write_inputs() on the pipeline. AR stages (decode, t2u_decode) additionally implement decode_prefill / decode_step contract with resident KV.

stages.name: encode
stages.role: text_encoder OR speech_encoder (chosen by input modality)

stages.name: prefill
stages.role: text_decoder run over the initial decoder_input_ids prompt (usually just decoder_start_token_id) seeding self+cross KV

stages.name: t2u_prefill
stages.role: t2u_model over the text_decoder tokens, seeding t2u self+cross KV

pipeline_stages_for_trace2cq.trace_region_sizing: Sized from the largest stage (encode with C=128, 24 layers, hidden=1024). If capture overflows, shrink C and PRINT the fallback.
pipeline_stages_for_trace2cq.release_between_stages: Each stage's trace is captured, executed once for self-test, and released BEFORE the next stage's capture — stage traces must not co-reside.

sanity_checks_done_at_planning_time.no_stub_missed: Every entry in bringup_status.json with status=NEW has a .last_good_native snapshot AND a live .py stub. Every entry is mapped into at least one task head.
sanity_checks_done_at_planning_time.no_reuse_confused_with_graduated: The 2 REUSE entries (seamless_m4_t_attention, seamless_m4_t_conformer_self_attention) point at models/tt_transformers/tt/attention.py and are NOT in the graduated list — they are absorbed by whichever module invokes attention (top-level encoder/decoder stubs already contain their own linear+softmax path).
